text_blocks.snippet: Hepatitis B treatment depends on whether it's acute or chronic. Acute hepatitis B often resolves on its own, requiring supportive care like rest, good nutrition, and hydration. Chronic hepatitis B, however, may be treated with antiviral medications or interferon injections to suppress viral replication and potentially prevent liver damage.

list.title: Monitoring:
